prompt: When interrupted, finish a silent count of three before you reply.
successSignal: You noticed at least one pause.
avoid: Do not grade the day pass/fail.

prompt: Offer one gentle answer where a sharp one would be easier.
successSignal: You chose softness once under tension.
avoid: Do not rehearse how others failed you.

prompt: Do one small second-mile act for someone who adds friction to your day.
successSignal: You acted beyond bare obligation once.
avoid: Do not announce it for credit.

prompt: Name two moments of hurry without fixing them yet — just notice.
successSignal: You can point to specific moments.
avoid: Do not stack self-condemnation onto the noticing.

prompt: Give someone full sentences of space before you interpret their motive.
successSignal: You listened longer than usual once.
avoid: Do not use listening as a trap for later correction.

prompt: Write one place patience grew and one place honesty shows you still need training.
successSignal: You can name both without shame language.
avoid: Do not flatten the season into a score.
